notes: Session and Today filters now follow your trading session, with fixes to success rates, re-test zones and the strategy plots.
changelog: Current Session Only now shows just the current session's zones, where before it showed almost all of them.
The Today filters count trading days instead of calendar days, so overnight sessions are grouped correctly.
The success rate now counts zones that break, not only zones that hold.
Keep Both now keeps the original zone and adds the re-test zone, instead of acting like Flip.
The Active Zones, Confluence and Strength plots used by strategies now update when Show Zones is off.
4h and Daily timeframes show a notice while they're still loading enough history.
